About.title: About
About.subtitle: I am a full-stack developer interested in building clear, solid, and maintainable products. I enjoy bringing design and technology together to create experiences that work well, feel great, and have purpose. I like turning complexity into something simple without losing impact or quality.
About.bio1: I specialize in developing complete web applications, from the initial idea to implementation. I combine frontend, backend, and architecture to create products that are fast, scalable, and easy to maintain.
About.bio2: In every project, I aim to understand the real problem, not just the requirements. I analyze the context, propose practical solutions, and lay the technical foundation for growth without friction. I care as much about the visible result as I do about what happens behind the scenes: architecture, performance, and best practices.

Portfolio.title: Portfolio
Portfolio.subtitle: A showcase of my work, demonstrating my skills and expertise in creating innovative and effective solutions for various projects.

items.title: E-Commerce Platform
items.description: Complete e-commerce platform with administration panel
detailsDescription: Complete e-commerce platform designed for a technology store. Includes product catalog, shopping cart, Stripe payment system, and administration panel for managing inventory and orders.
The system was built with Next.js 14 and TypeScript to ensure performance and type-safety. SSR was implemented to improve SEO and initial page loading.
The administration panel allows sellers to manage products, view real-time sales statistics, and process orders. PostgreSQL was used for the database with Prisma as ORM.

items.title: Task Management App
items.description: Task management application with real-time collaboration
detailsDescription: Task management application designed for remote teams. Allows creating projects, assigning tasks, setting deadlines, and collaborating in real-time with instant updates.
The backend architecture uses Node.js with Express and Socket.io for real-time communication. Redis was implemented for session caching and message queues.
The frontend was built with React and Context API for state management. Drag & drop was implemented to reorganize tasks and a real-time notification system.

items.title: Brand Identity System
items.description: Complete visual identity system for technology brand
detailsDescription: Development of a complete visual identity system for an emerging technology company. The project included logo, color palette, typography, and brand guidelines.
More than 50 digital assets were created including icons, illustrations, and social media templates. All pieces were designed in Figma with reusable components.
The system was documented in an interactive brand book that includes usage examples, technical specifications, and best practices for brand implementation across different media.

items.title: Fitness Tracker
items.description: Mobile app for tracking exercise routines and nutrition
detailsDescription: Cross-platform mobile app for tracking exercise routines and nutrition plans. Users can log workouts, monitor progress, and receive personalized recommendations.
Built with React Native to reach both iOS and Android with a single codebase. Firebase provides authentication, real-time database, and push notifications.
The Chart.js charting system shows user progress over time, including weight, body measurements, and performance in specific exercises.

items.title: Analytics Dashboard
items.description: Analytics panel with real-time data visualization
detailsDescription: Enterprise analytics dashboard with real-time data visualization. Allows monitoring KPIs, generating automatic reports, and making data-driven decisions.
The frontend uses Vue.js with D3.js for custom interactive charts. Communication with the backend is done via WebSockets for real-time updates.
The backend is built with Python and FastAPI, processing millions of daily events with ClickHouse as an analytical database for high-performance queries.

items.title: Restaurant Branding
items.description: Complete visual identity for gourmet restaurant chain
detailsDescription: Complete brand identity creation for a gourmet restaurant chain. The project covered everything from concept to implementation across all touchpoints.
Menus, business cards, signage, packaging, and a website were designed to reflect the restaurant's elegance and quality. Warm colors and sophisticated typography were used.
The project included 3D renders of interior design and printed material mockups for client presentation. Over 200 production-ready files were delivered.

items.title: Learning Platform
items.description: E-learning platform with course and progress system
detailsDescription: Complete e-learning platform with course system, video lessons, quizzes, and progress tracking. Includes instructor panel and per-course payment system.
The architecture uses Next.js App Router with Server Components to improve performance. Prisma ORM manages the PostgreSQL database with schemas optimized for complex queries.
Videos are stored in AWS S3 with adaptive streaming. A digital certificate system was implemented that automatically generates certificates upon course completion.

items.title: Social Media Toolkit
items.description: Toolkit for social media content management
detailsDescription: Comprehensive tool for social media content management. Allows scheduling posts, analyzing metrics, and managing multiple accounts from a single panel.
Built with Svelte for optimal performance and Supabase as backend-as-a-service. The scheduling system uses cron jobs to automatically publish content.
An integrated image editor was implemented with Canvas API that allows creating and editing posts directly on the platform without external tools.

items.title: Corporate Website
items.description: Corporate website with content management system
detailsDescription: Modern corporate website with headless CMS to facilitate content updates by the marketing team. Includes services section, case studies, and blog.
Next.js provides static rendering for content pages and SSR for dynamic content. Sanity CMS allows editing content in real-time with instant preview.
Smooth animations were implemented with Framer Motion and a responsive design that adapts perfectly to all devices. The site scored 98 on Lighthouse.

Services.title: Services
Services.subtitle: I offer a range of services to help you build and enhance your digital presence, from web development to design and optimization.

items.title: Full-Stack Web Development
items.description: Complete web applications built from frontend to backend, with a clear structure, reliable functionality, and room to grow.
features: Authentication, authorization, and security best practices
longDescription: I build complete web applications from the ground up, handling everything from database design and backend logic to responsive frontend interfaces. Each project is structured for maintainability and growth, using modern frameworks and proven architectural patterns.
Whether you need a new product built from scratch or an existing system improved, I focus on clean code, clear documentation, and reliable functionality that your team can extend over time.

process.description: Understanding your business goals, technical requirements, and user needs to define a clear project scope.
Designing the system structure, data models, API contracts, and technology stack selection.
Building the application in iterative sprints with regular demos and feedback cycles.
Thorough QA, performance testing, deployment setup, and production monitoring.

items.title: Frontend & UX
items.description: Responsive and intuitive interfaces that combine thoughtful user experiences with clean, maintainable frontend code.
features: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Design system and reusable component libraries
Animation and micro-interactions with GSAP/Framer Motion
longDescription: I create modern, responsive web interfaces that look great and work seamlessly across all devices. Using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, I build component-driven UIs that are fast, accessible, and easy to maintain.
From landing pages to complex dashboards, I focus on clean visual hierarchy, smooth interactions, and performance that keeps users engaged.

process.description: Analyzing user behavior, competitor patterns, and defining the information architecture.
Creating low-fidelity layouts to validate structure and user flows before visual design.
Building high-fidelity mockups with a consistent design system and component tokens.
Pixel-perfect implementation with responsive breakpoints, animations, and accessibility.

items.title: Backend & API Development
items.description: Well-structured APIs and backend services designed to connect systems, manage data, and support dependable digital products.
features: Rate limiting, caching, and security hardening
longDescription: I design and build robust backend services and APIs that power modern web applications. From simple REST endpoints to complex microservices, I focus on clean architecture, data integrity, and reliable performance under load.
Whether you need authentication systems, real-time features, or integrations with external services, I build backends that are secure, well-documented, and built to scale.

process.description: Mapping out data flows, endpoints, authentication needs, and integration points.
Designing the database schema, relationships, and indexing strategy.
Building endpoints with validation, error handling, and comprehensive documentation.
Security audit, load testing, caching layers, and monitoring setup.

items.title: Database Solutions
items.description: Practical database design and SQL solutions that keep information organized, accessible, and ready for application growth.
features: NoSQL solutions with MongoDB and Redis
Schema design for complex business requirements
longDescription: I design and implement database solutions that keep your data organized, accessible, and performant as your application grows. From relational schemas to document stores, I choose the right tool for each use case.
Whether you need a new database designed from scratch or an existing one optimized for better performance, I focus on data integrity, query efficiency, and scalable architecture.

process.description: Understanding data relationships, access patterns, and performance requirements.
Creating entity-relationship diagrams, normalization, and indexing strategy.
Building the schema, migrations, seed data, and query optimization.
Performance benchmarking, slow query analysis, and indexing refinements.

items.title: AI Automation & Agents
items.description: Intelligent automations and AI agents built with n8n to streamline repetitive workflows, connect tools, and help teams work more efficiently.
features: Workflow automation with n8n and custom integrations
AI-powered agents for data processing and decision-making
Monitoring and error handling for production workflows
longDescription: I build intelligent automations and AI agents that streamline repetitive workflows and connect your tools seamlessly. Using n8n and custom integrations, I create systems that handle routine tasks so your team can focus on what matters.
From simple data syncing to complex multi-step workflows with AI decision-making, I design automations that are reliable, observable, and easy to modify as your needs evolve.

process.description: Mapping your current workflows, identifying bottlenecks and automation opportunities.
Architecting the automation flow, triggers, error handling, and data mapping.
Implementing workflows in n8n with custom nodes, AI integrations, and testing.
Production setup with monitoring, alerting, and documentation for your team.

items.title: Cross-Platform Mobile Development
items.description: Cross-platform mobile applications built with Flutter for consistent, responsive experiences across Android and iOS.
features: Single codebase for Android and iOS
Custom UI with Flutter widgets and animations
App Store and Play Store deployment support
longDescription: I build cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter that deliver native-like performance on both Android and iOS from a single codebase. From concept to deployment, I handle UI design, business logic, and platform integration.
Whether you need a consumer-facing app or an internal tool, I focus on smooth animations, fast load times, and a consistent experience across all devices.

process.description: Defining platform requirements, screen flows, and native feature needs.
Creating platform-adaptive designs that follow Material Design and Cupertino guidelines.
Building the app with Flutter widgets, state management, and API integrations.
App Store and Play Store submission, screenshots, metadata, and release management.
